# taba_topics (Data Source)

Lists the topics the token reaches, sorted by name, with optional filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The queues of the billing team whose name contains "orders".
data "taba_topics" "billing_orders" {
  name_contains = "orders"
  type          = "queue"
  tags = {
    team = "billing"
  }
}

output "names" {
  value = data.taba_topics.billing_orders.names
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `include_dead_letters` (Boolean) Also list the dead-letter queues. Default: `false`.
- `name_contains` (String) Only the topics whose name contains this text (case-sensitive).
- `tags` (Map of String) Only the topics that have all these tags, with these values.
- `type` (String) Only `queue` or only `distributor`.

### Read-Only

- `names` (List of String) The names of the topics found.
- `topics` (Attributes List) The topics found. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--topics))

<a id="nestedatt--topics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `topics`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation date (RFC 3339).
- `dead_letter` (Boolean) True on a dead-letter queue.
- `effective_max_deliveries` (Number) The max_deliveries in force.
- `effective_max_message_bytes` (Number) The max_message_bytes in force.
- `effective_ttl` (Number) The ttl in force.
- `fifo` (Boolean) FIFO queue.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the topic.
- `idle_timeout` (Number) Volatile queue only: seconds without a consumer until removal.
- `max_deliveries` (Number) Declared deliveries before the dead-letter (null: the node default).
- `max_message_bytes` (Number) Declared maximum message size (null: the node default).
- `name` (String) Name of the topic.
- `prefixes` (List of String) Distributor only: the destination prefixes (null on a queue).
- `source` (String) Dead-letter queue only: the queue it belongs to.
- `tags` (Map of String) Telemetry tags.
- `ttl` (Number) Declared message lifetime, in seconds (null: the node default).
- `type` (String) `queue` or `distributor`.
- `volatile` (Boolean) Volatile queue.
